column3: Initial Invasion and Ukrainian Counter Offensives
Russian forces retreat from northern Ukraine after failing to capture Kyiv
Mariupol falls after a prolonged siege
Ukraine launches a successful counteroffensive in the Kharkiv region, regaining large territories
Ukraine recaptures Kherson, marking another major territorial shift
The war settles into a grinding attritional phase, with slow territorial changes. Data shows the frontline stabilizing with minor advances and setbacks
Ukrainian cross-border raids into Russia’s Kursk region occurred, indicating an escalation in offensive tactics
Ukraine’s offensive leads to temporary gains but is met with Russian counterattacks, resulting in near encirclement of Ukrainian forces
Russia escalates missile and drone strikes on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure, while international dynamics shift as the U.S. halts intelligence sharing and peace discussions
